senses.definition: a companion of Zerubbabel Ezr 2:2 = Ne 7:7; perhaps = head of a family of returning exiles Ezr 2:14 (בִּגְוָ֑י) = Ne 7:19, cf. Ezr 8:14.
a chief of the people in Nehemiah’s time Ne 10:17; cf. SmListen 13.
